## Required Before Production

- `DEPLOY-001` — **Production configuration defaults to debug mode** (high, material technical-quality impact, required_before_production, P1; supported). An incomplete production configuration could expose verbose error details. Recommendation: Use a production-safe default or fail startup when the setting is absent. ## Recommended After Release

- `ARCH-001` — **Order orchestration concentrates unrelated collaborators** (medium, localized technical-quality impact, post_release, P2; supported). Pricing and notification changes increase regression scope in order processing. Recommendation: Retain orchestration but isolate pricing policy and notification dispatch behind explicit collaborators.
